title: Principal Healthcare Implementation Specialist
description: Christus Health seeks a talented Principal Healthcare Implementation Specialist to lead our athenahealth implementation initiatives. You will work closely with clinical stakeholders, IT teams, and executive leadership to deliver solutions that improve efficiency and patient outcomes. Experience with athenahealth Core is essential.
responsibilities: Collaborate with clinical stakeholders to gather requirements and design optimal workflows
Configure and customize athenahealth applications to meet organizational needs
Develop and maintain project documentation, including design specifications and test plans
Participate in system testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
Provide go-live support and post-implementation optimization
Lead end-to-end athenahealth implementation projects from planning through go-live
Design and build clinical workflows within the EHR system
Conduct workflow analysis sessions with clinical departments
Manage data migration and system integration activities
Coordinate with third-party vendors and interface partners

required_qualifications.experience: 7+ years of healthcare IT implementation experience

certifications: Certified Associate in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CAHIMS)
